title: Hydrolytic instability of C–F bonds in 2,2,2-trifluoroethyl-phosphinic acid systems: formation of carboxymethylphosphinic acid derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49109-49118
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07303K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Filip Koucký, Ivana Císařová, Jan Kotek
A rare example of hydrolytic instability of the C–F bond: the trifluoromethyl group in 2,2,2-trifluoroethylphosphinic acids undergoes alkaline hydrolysis and forms carboxymethylphosphinate and fluoride.
